title: TCG:PRO-19B

objectives.text:
Each player puts a Lich into their zone 1 with 3 counters on it and controls it.
If a Lich would be KO'd, remove 1 counter from it instead. Then, if it has no counters, put it onto its controller's zone 1 ready with 3 counters on it.
If a player scores 9 points, they win.
At the end of round 7, the player with the most pints wins.
